title: Implement and replay the full-body forward trajectory optimizer
summary: The first optimized cycle moves the approved robot 0.967614 m in a 20-second native replay. Motor, joint and contact checks pass; speed variation fails the unchanged tracking gate. The implementation preserves source-bound solver inputs, actual state transitions and native video. No PPO training or Stage 2 acceptance occurs.
next: Review within-cycle speed variation before accepting optimized references for learning. Keep the existing model, motor limits and acceptance gates.
